query: SELECT proposal->'attack' AS "report!",to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS "saved_at!" FROM tasks WHERE tenant=$1 AND run_actor=$2 AND run_request ? 'attack' AND run_request->'attack'->>'channel'=$3 AND (run_request->>'agentId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4 ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT 1
